weeks.focus: Feature C, CI/CD, deployment, docs & case study

Add basic end-to-end smoke test (e.g., Playwright or simple Cypress smoke) or expanded integration tests; ensure test coverage for critical flows.
Finalize the one-page case study, update README with setup/deploy instructions, and confirm live demo + repo link in case study.
